zones.name: Insertion & Stealth Movement Course
zones.description: Dense pine tree line and boulder cover leading to the low crawl trench at (60, 55) and gravel noise hazard M01_T8_01 at (75, 62).

zones.name: Indoor Close-Quarters & Lockpick/Vent House
zones.description: 1-story concrete training kill-house ([180, 25] to [260, 85]) with 4 entry points (front, back, roof hatch ladder, vent shaft) and 3 interior rooms (R1 Entry, R2 Control Room, R3 Vault/Office).

zones.name: Central Fenced Yard & Tripwire Alley
zones.description: Continuous chain-link fenced yard along y=105 and y=155 with sliding gate at (130, 105), cuttable fence at (45, 105), tripwires, gravel trap, pressure plate shed, and guard booth at (142, 110).

zones.name: West Perimeter Watchtower & Pillbox
zones.description: West perimeter sector with metal watchtower at (40, 210) and concrete pillbox bunker at (95, 195) fortified with sandbag walls.

zones.name: Live Guard Compound & Command Tent
zones.description: Live infiltration compound ([165, 175] to [285, 275]) with watchtower at (275, 185), camera M01_T11_02 at (195, 180), alarm panel M01_ALM_01 at (215, 220), Command Tent at (220, 230), and 4 E1 Militia Grunts.

zones.name: North Extraction Hut
zones.description: Northern extraction clearing with Briefing/Extraction Hut at (150, 295) (radius 10.0m).

primary.title: Pass stations A to E and reach Command Tent at (220, 230)

secondary.title: Disable security camera monitor in Zone B Control Room
Collect all 3 Trainer Notes & finish Zone E without raising an alert (Ghost Medal)

silent.name: Silent Route (Wire Cutters, Crouch/Prone Trench & West Fence Breach)
silent.description: Crawl through Zone A trench (60, 55), cut Zone C West fence at (45, 105) & disarm M01_T1_01, advance along West compound road to (160, 230), enter Command Tent West doorway to (220, 230), and extract at (150, 295).

technical.name: Technical Route (Zone B Vent/Lockpick, Camera Monitor Disable & Gate Access)
technical.description: Advance from (20, 10) to Zone B Vent Shaft (210, 25), enter R2 Control Room at (210, 52) to disable camera monitor M01_MON_01 (S1), exit North to (210, 165), enter Command Tent South doorway to (220, 230), and extract at (150, 295).

loud.name: Loud / Overwatch Route (Sandbag Cover, Watchtower Overwatch & Direct Breach)
loud.description: Advance through Zone A boulder cover (105, 65), breach Central Gate at (130, 105), secure overwatch near Zone D Pillbox corridor at (95, 230), assault Command Tent (220, 230), and extract at (150, 295).
